metadata.description: Shiny agent skills for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI

plugins.name: shiny
plugins.description: Every Shiny library for .NET in one plugin — cross-platform mobile & device client libraries (BLE client & peripheral, GPS, geofencing, background jobs, local & push notifications, HTTP background transfers, JSON data sync, OBD-II over BLE/WiFi/serial, music, health, contacts, calendar, Wi-Fi scan/connect/hotspot, local network discovery via mDNS/SSDP/WS-Discovery, speech-to-text/TTS, AI conversation with wake word, hosting/DI), an AOT-clean embedded HTTP/1.1/2/3 server, .NET MAUI components (Shell navigation with source-generated routes, hosting modules, device/app info), shared MAUI & Blazor UI controls (TableView, TreeView, FloatingPanel, ChatView, ImageViewer/Editor, scheduler, Markdown, barcodes/QR), Mediator/CQRS with middleware & source generators, AOT-friendly data (DocumentDb over SQLite/LiteDB/Cosmos/Mongo/DynamoDB/Redis/RavenDB/Firestore/DuckDB/IndexedDB/major SQL, Spatial geodata, native Firestore for iOS/Android), .NET Aspire integrations, and source generators & utilities.
